encoding.unchanged_obligations: 64 original matrix, 3 structure and 3 jagged claims; public Q remains two Fr limbs; all transcript and root constraints remain.
encoding.selection: Explicit proof-free mode, fixed on a fresh builder before any allocation or constraint. Both emitters reject ambient cache/product selection. Old uncached and Boolean-carry modes preserve their geometry and identities.
encoding.cache: Same exact-wire FIFO, capacity 1024; source values and randomized hash iteration do not select topology.

range_argument.coefficient_encoding: b + 2*c, with Boolean b and one Fr carry c in {0,...,floor(N/2)}, N the number of input-bit products contributing to the coefficient.
range_argument.integer_bound: Both packed products and digit sums are below 2^160, below Fr's modulus. Each digit is below radix 32. Equality in Fr therefore fixes the exact integer convolution and its characteristic-two parity without carry or modular aliases.
range_argument.polynomial: With m the maximum and p=c(c-m), p+i(m-i)=(c-i)(c-(m-i)). The emitted product trees multiply these factors. Only m=4,6,8 duplicate the middle root; duplication changes multiplicity, not the allowed values.
range_argument.unchanged: Operand preparation, its defining XOR/pack constraints, 27-leaf Karatsuba reconstruction and GHASH field reduction.

component_counts.name: four products with one common operand
four products with both operands repeated

count_scope: Complete component counts including input allocation, not whole-relation counts or whole-relation percentage savings. Each 16-bit leaf saves 34 rows, times 27 leaves = 918 per dense product. Shape and assigned counts agree; explicit preparations and cache reuse have equal costs. Capacity-one no-reuse tests retain the same 918-row product saving.

checks: Symbolic elimination of each actual emitted range R1CS yields exactly the factored polynomial, compared coefficient by coefficient over Fr; this is an executable algebraic regression, not a Lean theorem.
All small integer roots pass; negative one, maximum+one, 19 and one-half reject with consistently recomputed auxiliary witnesses. Every product auxiliary mutation rejects.
All convolution widths 1 through 16 match an independent carryless parity oracle for zero, mixed and all-one inputs; every input, pack, parity, carry and auxiliary wire mutation rejects.
Complete materialized F128 2x2-product matrices are identical across zero/mixed/all-one seeds and setup emission; every input/output/pack mutation rejects.
Ranged cache capacities 1,2,4 preserve complete materialized setup/assignment equality across three seeds and bounded FIFO eviction; malformed/late configuration and sticky failures reject.
Actual materialized PLONK lowering matches the component projection and checks every lowered witness gate.
All old arithmetic tests and row goldens pass. Six actual native Exec proofs across both prepared modes pass setup ownership and prefix comparisons; these are not whole-matrix equality checks.
Workspace Clippy with warnings denied, formatting, and the complete ordinary workspace suite pass.
regressions.development_scope: Existing small FFLONK proofs use deterministic development setup/blinding. No full closed-relation FFLONK proof or production setup is established by these tests.
